title: Detect and Remove the Extra Edge in a Tree
description:
Reworded Problem Description:

A tree is defined as an undirected graph that is fully connected and contains no cycles.

You are given a graph that was originally a tree with n nodes labeled from 1 to n. However, one extra edge was added between two distinct nodes, creating exactly one cycle.

The graph is represented as an array edges of size n, where each element edges[i] = [a, b] indicates an undirected edge between nodes a and b.

Your task is to identify and return one edge that can be removed so that the graph becomes a valid tree again (i.e., connected and acyclic).

If multiple edges could be removed to achieve this, return the one that appears last in the input array.
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
